findings: Main SHA/QA verified by direct compare: only two generated status files since successful main QA; PR #94 exact-head CI both jobs passed, including trusted-base scope and immutable claim checks.
PR has three files, +2785 server bytes and C00065 ledger; character, provider, release, budget and accepted test controls unchanged.

Code-level safety defect: UpdateAsync transform ignores its current stored value. Mock UpdateAsync already passes old value but no test changes stored version or simulates competing writes between join and save.

Official Roblox GlobalDataStore documentation confirms UpdateAsync transform receives latest stored value, nil cancels write, and cross-server changes can invoke callback again; current code cannot reject stale/unknown records.
blockers: src/ToyWarsServer.server.lua saveProgress(): UpdateAsync callback function() return record end ignores the current stored value; a newer/unknown schema written after GetAsync is overwritten on PlayerRemoving, contradicting the claimed unknown-schema protection.

A stale earlier server/session can save after a newer session and replace newer version-1 progress; current seven Lua cases do not exercise interleaved UpdateAsync writes or a version change between read and save.
reproduction: Initialize DataStore mock p:1={version=1,coins=200,wave=2,defeated=1,factoryLevel=1}; join player; before h:removePlayer(p), mutate store.data['p:1'] to {version=2,coins=900,...}. Current saveProgress UpdateAsync callback returns stale version=1 record and overwrites version=2. Expected: preserve version=2 and report/cancel unsafe write.

Create two independent canonical server fixtures sharing one store and same UserId. Both load v1; newer fixture saves coins=500 first; older fixture then saves coins=200. Current unconditional callback replaces 500 with 200. Expected: reject stale writer, preserve newer record.
limitations: Findings are deterministic code-path analysis; no Roblox engine, live DataStore or multi-server test executed.
PR's seven offline cases pass, but none exercise interleaved version/stale-session writes.
next_action: WORKER fixes UpdateAsync version/current-value and stale-session protection with whole-server adversarial regressions; fresh exact-head CI and independent re-review required.
